title: 🔆🔅 TEHRAN- October 3rd - Brigadier General Ali Balali, Senior advisor to the commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Aerospace Force, made the following remarks.
text:
🔆🔅 TEHRAN- October 3rd - Brigadier General Ali Balali, Senior advisor to the commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Aerospace Force, made the following remarks."
" "
"SOT1, Ali Balali, Senior advisor to the commander of the IRGC Aerospace Force (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:43): "We build all the facilities we need in the missile sector ourselves, and we are capable of exporting them. In drones, air defense, and space—these are areas where we started, and using the experience we gained, we have made progress. We have reached a point where, in the drone sector, the United States has copied our Shahed-136. This demonstrates the level of determination and will behind this achievement; those who possess all the think tanks, research, and development centers could not build it themselves and are instead copying from us.""

"SOT2, Ali Balali, Senior advisor to the commander of the IRGC Aerospace Force (Farsi)-(00:44 - 01:14): "We have made progress in the missile field in sectors that involve the latest global technologies. The nozzles used for our missiles are made of carbon fiber and can withstand temperatures of 3,000 degrees and pressures of 100 atmospheres. Who built these? Our own scientists, our own students—individuals who worked in this country, studied, and had the belief and confidence in themselves that they could do it, and so they did.""

"SOT3, Ali Balali, Senior advisor to the commander of the IRGC Aerospace Force (Farsi)-(01:15 - 02:08): "We do not really rest; we are always striving and meeting our own needs in the aerospace field. Thankfully, there is continuity among the components related to this work, and it is occurring across all the sectors we require. We are grateful that we have been able to maintain this steadfastness so far, and there is no cause for concern. What you are seeing now is that the Americans are raising concerns about their reserves of interceptor missiles and the like, and they are truly at a loss as to what to do. However, we are not in that situation, and thank God, we can continue this battle for as long as necessary, given the capabilities being developed by our Ministry of Defense and other sectors.
